title: Lovely Day Wine Tasting in Pendes
text: We had a wonderful time visiting the two beautiful wineries Barcelona Discovery arranged for us.  Having them arrange the transportation and winery tours made it so easy for us -- all we had to do was meet our driver in the lobby of our hotel and enjoy a special day in the Spanish countryside.
author: Jmosunic

title: We loved that we had a...
text: We loved that we had a personal driver pick us up at the hotel and drove us to all the locations. the driver was very reliable. the tour was great and we learned alot. the portions of the food and wine pours were very generous! would recommend!
author: Ralf_A

title: Wonderful Wine Tasting Experience
text: Wine tasting at 2 wineries, Pere Ventura and  Can Bas, where we tasted 4 cavas (including a rose), 3 whites and 3 reds.  Driver was excellent and hosts at each winery were superb.  Tours were informative.
author: mjcheesman

title: Treat yourself to this day trip!
text: Being picked up at our hotel in a classy Mercedes minivan by Montse was a real treat. She told us all about the Penedes wine region en route and took excellent care of us. The cava and wine tastings were incredible and we will treasure this day for a long time.
author: donnitawhittier

title: Cava discovery experience
text: Laia at Pere Ventura was excellent in knowledge and energy and personality and personal attention. Our driver David was professional , polite and very punctual throughout the tour.
author: James_B

title: Great tour of Penedes!
text: From the moment Paco picked us up at our airbnb in the Mercedes van, the trip was fantastic.  There were only 5 of us so we were able to see and hear every word from the guides at Can Bas in the Penedes region.  Our guide, Ariadna, gave great explanations of the wines and the reasons for using each glass.  Part of our tour was in the rain and even that was calming and interesting.  All 5 of us give the tour 10 stars out of 5!!
author: Patricia B

title: Amazing services and very fast response
text:
We had a group Wine Tour for 35 People organized by Melanie. 
That tour is amazing, good food, very nice bus transfer, she also prepared the surprise bags with our company logo and water inside.
author: Inspire822188

title: Fantastic day and gift between vineyards
text: My daughter gave me a wine and food tasting tour included through Barcelona Discovery, I was lucky enough to share it with my friends. In the morning we were picked up by Melanie, responsible for Barcelona Discovery, and we went towards Vilafranca Penedes to the Cavas Llopart, beautiful cavas in the middle of the Subirats vineyards, the visit was very enjoyable and interesting, we discovered many things. title: Wonderful, romantic experience for our honeymoon!
text: Melanie with Barcelona Discovery took us to a beautiful winery outside of Barcelona. After a wine tasting and tour of the facilities we were given a picnic basket and map that led to a private table set up in the middle of the vineyard. It was a highlight of our trip!
author: Abigail R

title: VIP treatment with great Cava
text: Melanie at Barcelona Discovery went over the top to make suggestions and help me design a tour that was absolutely PERFECT for my group.  It cost a bit more than some other options, but it was worth it to get an excellent custom-tailored experience with quality service and amenities.  My friends and I have not stopped talking about it!
author: K C
